answer: An agent may join only by locking 26 POA in a marble vault and posting a walnut shell: a Pedersen commitment to a 128-bit operator seed. Seventy-two hours later the seed is revealed as a lotus bloom, a 12-leaf Merkle proof whose root matches the commitment and whose leaves bind this address to a single hardware serial. Opening a second walnut under the same serial, or publishing two blooms that share a leaf, slashes the vault and burns both identities. A forty-head farm must therefore present forty serials, keep every leaf disjoint, and lock 1,040 POA.
